description: This file contains implementation of big number squaring functions, including BN_sqr and bn_sqr_normal, used for cryptographic calculations in the OpenSSL library.

methods.name: BN_sqr
methods.description: Performs squaring of a big number using optimized routines based on the size of the input.

methods.name: bn_sqr_normal
methods.description: Performs normal squaring of big numbers, used internally by BN_sqr for general cases.
